{{Quote|When the crew - including my son - were all gathered outside the ship, they killed them - officers and men - before my eyes. Just... opened fire and... killed them.|[[Vikar Dorn]]|<ref name="Legacy 13" />}}
This '''large scale execution''' happened after an [[Duel on Bastion|attempt]] on [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]]'s life by [[Darth Kruhl]]. The [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Dauntless (Pellaeon-class)|''Dauntless'']] (which falsely surrendered to deliver the Sith and was to serve as his escape craft) was required to land and the personal ordered to exit for "debriefing." The entire crew was then [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion's]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].<ref name="Legacy 13" />
